theme_and_archetype.description: A grounded, trustworthy, and traditional yet modern design for a rural Indian dairy collection center.

headings.usage: Used for all primary numbers, stats, and large headers to feel modern and clear.

body.usage: Used for all standard UI text, Marathi + English bilingual labels, and data tables.

primary.description: Dark Green for trust, agriculture, and brand identity.

accent.description: Gold/Amber for highlights, money/rupees, and primary CTAs.

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FDFBF7] shadow-xl
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100
general_rules: Ensure all tap targets (buttons, inputs) are at least 48px high for thumb-friendliness.
Use optical alignment. Pad numbers to align right in tables.
Make numeric inputs very large (text-2xl or text-3xl).

Header.style: Sticky top, white background with subtle shadow, features the CSS-built brand logo (green oval, white 'Siddhnath', black 'Doodh Sankalan Kendra' below).
Header.actions: User profile or logout on the right.

Login_Screen.layout: Splash image at the top, followed by brand logo, then a large segmented control to toggle between Admin and Farmer roles.
Login_Screen.inputs: Farmer ID, Phone number. Very large input fields.

Admin_Dashboard.layout: Bento grid style. Top card: Today's Collection (Liters, Amount). Middle: Quick actions (Add Milk, Add Farmer). Bottom: Recent entries.
Admin_Dashboard.fab: Large floating action button or fixed bottom bar for 'Add Milk Entry'.

Add_Milk_Entry.flow: Select Farmer -> Camera/Manual Entry toggle -> Inputs (Fat%, SNF%, Liters) -> Auto-calculated Rate & Total -> Save -> WhatsApp Slip.
Add_Milk_Entry.camera_ui: A simulated scanner view with corner brackets and a scanning line animation for AI reading.

Farmer_Dashboard.layout: Personalized view. Top: My total collection, Rate, Advance balance. Bottom: List of recent daily entries.

WhatsApp_Button.style: bg-[#25D366] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2
WhatsApp_Button.behavior: Generates the Marathi text slip and links to wa.me API.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Not heavily applicable as this is a mobile-first app, but use scale-95 on active/tap states for buttons.
interactions_and_motion.page_transitions: Slide-in from right or bottom for new screens (e.g., opening camera).
interactions_and_motion.loading: Use a subtle rotating milk/drop icon or simple spinner in brand green.

specific_icons: MessageCircle for WhatsApp (if specific icon not found, use a chat icon colored green)

farmer_portraits.description: Indian farmer smiling (use for mock farmer profile)
Indian farmer with bucket (use for mock farmer profile)

dairy_splash.description: Dairy cows on field (use for splash screen background or auth screen background with heavy overlay)

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case and role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app as a mobile-first web app, constrained to max-w-md and centered on desktop, taking full width on mobile.
Build the brand logo using HTML/CSS: A green oval (rounded-full) with white text 'Siddhnath' inside, and a smaller black text 'Doodh Sankalan Kendra' placed immediately below it.
Ensure all input fields for numbers use type='number' and have large text sizes (text-2xl) for easy typing.
Mock the AI photo reading functionality with a setTimeout and a scanning animation overlay. After 2 seconds, auto-fill Fat% and SNF%.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn components for forms, inputs, and dialogs.
Include 'data-testid' on every button, input, and critical data display element.
